title: Anomaly.Group.Members
description: Snapshot (module Anomaly.Group): the character's party as `par` shows it, in `par`'s order (members by formation rank front, middle, back, then name; invited characters after them), plus whether each is in the receiver's room. leader is the party's leader (leadership is not a rank); null with members empty: not in a party. A sysop-invisible character is never listed to anyone who could not see them (the 1.0.0 occupants rule). Sent on any change, on subscription and on request.

membership.description: member: in the party; invited: invited by the leader and not yet joined (engine invitation state, apart from the rank)

rank.description: formation rank (the engine's PartyRank), set by front, middle and back; a joiner starts middle. The leader has one too

hpPct.description: as `par` prints it (GameWorld.PartyHitsPercent): floor(hp * 100 / maxhp), capped at 100 for a member buffed past their maximum, NO lower bound: a dropped ally below 0 HP reads negative (any HP below 0 reads at least -1), so healers see who is down. 0 for no maximum. Never clamped to 0 on the server

manaPct.description: mana or kai percent, clamped 0..100 as `par` does; null for a class without either
